modules.name: pmake
build:
printf '%s
' '# $(MAKE) for the modules below: BusyBox make runs one command at a time (no -j). In a' '# directory at all-am, once its BUILT_SOURCES (gnulib headers) are made, or at an all that' '# is all-am alone, the compiles make would run first run $(nproc) at a time, after the' '# .dirstamp files that objects in subdirectories depend on (made later, they are newer).' 'case ${MAKEFLAGS%% *} in -*n*) exec make "$@" ;; esac' 'case " $* " in' '*" all-am "*) ;;' '*" all "*) grep -qx "all: all-am" Makefile || exec make "$@" ;;' '*) exec make "$@" ;;' 'esac' 'n=$(make -n "$@")' 'printf "%s
" "$n" | grep -o "[^ >]*/[.]dirstamp" | sort -u | while read -r f; do mkdir -p "${f%/*}" && : >>"$f"; done' 'printf "%s
" "$n" | grep -e " -c -o " | tr "
" "\0" | xargs -0 -r -P "$(nproc)" -n 1 sh -c || :' 'exec make "$@"' > pmake.sh

modules.name: libiconv
build: sh ./configure --disable-dependency-tracking --build=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --prefix="$PREFIX" --disable-static --enable-relocatable --disable-nls lt_cv_deplibs_check_method=pass_all gl_cv_cc_visibility=no > configure.log 2>&1 || { tail -60 config.log; exit 1; }
make MAKE="sh B:/src/pmake/pmake.sh" > make.log 2>&1 || { tail -80 make.log; exit 1; }
make install > install.log 2>&1 || { tail -60 install.log; exit 1; }

modules.name: gettext
build: sh ./configure -C --disable-dependency-tracking --build=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32 --prefix="$PREFIX" --disable-static --enable-relocatable --disable-java --disable-csharp --disable-openmp --disable-curses --disable-libasprintf --without-emacs --without-git --without-cvs --without-bzip2 --without-xz --enable-threads=windows --with-libiconv-prefix=B:/prefix lt_cv_deplibs_check_method=pass_all gl_cv_cc_visibility=no > configure.log 2>&1 || { tail -40 configure.log; for f in config.log */config.log; do echo "== $f"; tail -60 $f; done; exit 1; }
make MAKE="sh B:/src/pmake/pmake.sh" MAKEINFO=true HELP2MAN=true > make.log 2>&1 || { tail -80 make.log; exit 1; }
make install INSTALL="install -c" MAKEINFO=true HELP2MAN=true > install.log 2>&1 || { tail -60 install.log; exit 1; }
